subject: Mythology
title: The Otherworld: Tir na nOg
description: A fast breakdown of The Otherworld: Tir na nOg for builders.

hook.text: The Celtic Otherworld was not above or below. It existed alongside our world, separated by a thin veil.

buildup.text: Tir na nOg was the Land of Eternal Youth, where no one aged, suffered, or knew hunger or sorrow.

discovery.text: Mortals could reach it through fairy mounds, across the sea, or at sacred times when the veil thinned.

twist.text: Time moved differently there. A few days in the Otherworld could be centuries in the mortal world.

climax.text: Heroes who returned found everyone they loved long dead, their world completely changed beyond recognition.

punchline.text: Paradise had a price: you could never truly come home.

quiz.question: What happened to time in the Celtic Otherworld?
options: Time stopped completely for anyone who entered
A few days there could equal centuries in the mortal world
Time moved backward, making visitors younger
